raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer made an initial error by failing to efficiently locate the relevant NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day for the first week of August 2015. Instead of employing a direct search strategy to quickly identify the APOD showing the lights of a city on the horizon, WebSurfer engaged in inefficient browsing and scrolling through the archive pages multiple times without success, which delayed the identification of the correct city. This inefficient approach led to a prolonged and repetitive process, ultimately contributing to the wrong solution being reached.
